results.description: EmpleosProyectos de Implementación Consultor Técnico — Salesforce Bogotá o Medellín (Híbrido — 1 día de oficina) Tiempo completo Operaciones Proyectos de Implementación Abierta desde el 14 de septiembre de 2026 En Colibrí IT somos una consultora boutique especializada en Salesforce, Field Service, Agentforce e Inteligencia Artificial. Trabajamos en proyectos de transformación digital para organizaciones en Colombia, Chile y Panamá, y contamos con más de 70 certificaciones vigentes en nuestro equipo. Buscamos un Consultor Técnico Salesforce para integrarse a nuestro equipo. Este cargo desarrollará las funciones de Consultor, participando en la construcción e integración de soluciones empresariales sobre Salesforce. ¿Qué harás como Consultor? Construirás y validarás componentes o módulos de complejidad media, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requerimientos, criterios de aceptación y estándares técnicos definidos para el proyecto. Analizarás requerimientos funcionales y técnicos, estimarás el esfuerzo de las actividades bajo tu responsabilidad e identificarás riesgos, dependencias y desviaciones. Coordinarás técnicamente la ejecución de tu frente y orientarás a Consultores Adjunto y Junior cuando participen en su construcción. También integrarás y validarás los componentes desarrollados, ejecutarás pruebas, documentarás decisiones técnicas y propondrás mejoras que aumenten la calidad, eficiencia y mantenibilidad de las soluciones. Tu rol como Consultor Técnico Salesforce En los proyectos donde seas asignado como Consultor Técnico, construirás las capacidades que requieren desarrollo a la medida y que exceden la configuración declarativa de la plataforma. Trabajarás con Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, APIs e integraciones, construyendo lógica de negocio, interfaces y componentes técnicos. También podrás participar en procesos de integración con sistemas externos, transformación y migración de datos y desarrollo de servicios o componentes necesarios para completar la solución. Serás responsable de que tus desarrollos sean probados, mantenibles, seguros y consistentes con el diseño definido para el proyecto, y apoyarás su integración con los componentes construidos por otros integrantes del equipo. La Inteligencia Artificial también hace parte de cómo desarrollamos software. Podrás utilizarla para apoyar análisis y diseño técnico, generación y revisión de código, construcción de pruebas, documentación, troubleshooting y refactorización, manteniendo siempre el criterio profesional sobre la solución entregada. El objetivo no es simplemente escribir código. Buscamos que desarrolles la capacidad de entender un problema técnico, diseñar una solución adecuada y responder por su construcción e integración dentro de un frente de trabajo. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos para el cargo? Buscamos profesionales titulados en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Computación, Software o carreras afines, con 3 años de experiencia profesional y experiencia construyendo soluciones de software. Para desenvolverte en nuestros proyectos y continuar desarrollando tu carrera profesional, necesitarás un nivel de inglés B1 o superior. El perfil que buscamos Buscamos personas con una actitud permanente de aprendizaje, curiosidad y mejora; con capacidad técnica y analítica sólida, pensamiento crítico, responsabilidad y facilidad para trabajar y colaborar con otros. Queremos profesionales que no se limiten a recibir una especificación y programarla, sino que se pregunten qué necesitamos resolver, para qué y por qué, evalúen si la solución propuesta es adecuada y sean capaces de identificar alternativas cuando exista una mejor forma de construirla. También esperamos que veas en la Inteligencia Artificial una herramienta cotidiana para potenciar tu capacidad como ingeniero, mejorar la calidad de tu trabajo y aumentar tu productividad. ¿Qué esperamos que conozcas? Esperamos bases sólidas en programación orientada a objetos, estructuras de datos, APIs REST, integración de sistemas, bases de datos, Git, pruebas automatizadas y buenas prácticas de desarrollo de software. Valoramos experiencia con Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce CLI y Salesforce DX, además de conocimientos en integración y migración de datos. Certificaciones como Salesforce Platform Developer serán un diferenciador. Buscamos que tengas los fundamentos y la experiencia necesarios para asumir con autonomía la construcción de un frente técnico y orientar a otros integrantes del equipo. En Colibrí IT podrás profundizar tu conocimiento y desarrollar especialización en Salesforce Development, integraciones, ingeniería de software y desarrollo apoyado por Inteligencia Artificial, con apoyo en formación, entrenamiento y certificaciones. Beneficios Contrato a término indefinido y tiempo completo Modalidad híbrida: 1 día por semana en oficina, en Bogotá o Medellín Buen ambiente laboral Plan de carrera Apoyo en formación, entrenamiento y certificaciones Auxilios de conectividad, salud y sostenimiento ¿No encuentras tu posición ideal? Envíanos tu hoja de vida y cuéntanos en qué área te gustaría trabajar. Siempre estamos buscando talento.

results.title: AI Engineer - Forward Deployed Engineer
results.language_note: Requiere inglés avanzado / profesional / C1 / fluido / excelente
results.description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Sales Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. AI ENGINEER Forward Deployed Engineer We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place. About The Role Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on. The Builder Experience AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow. Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself. Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers. What You'll Actually Be Building Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it. Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques. Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production. Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes. Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months. Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before. Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop. Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship. You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If… You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands. You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change. You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them. You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects. You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor. You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next. You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it. You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers. Nice-to-Haves Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist) Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

results.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Consumer Mobile team builds the Kraken app, the interface millions of people use to interact with their money. We work primarily in React Native, building products that make complex financial experiences intuitive, fast and trustworthy. We're a product-minded engineering team. Our engineers don't just implement requirements: they work closely with Product and Design to understand the problem behind them, challenge assumptions, shape solutions and measure whether what we ship actually improves the experience for our clients. The opportunity We're looking for a Senior React Native Engineer who thinks like a product builder. You'll work across engineering, product and design to turn real client problems into thoughtful mobile experiences, comfortable starting with an ambiguous problem rather than a perfectly defined specification. You'll own features end-to-end, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through implementation, launch and iteration, using data and client feedback to drive improvements. You'll build high-quality experiences in React Native across a financial product where responsiveness, reliability and trust matter, whether improving product discovery, creating trading experiences, or simplifying journeys. You'll partner closely with Product and Design, contributing engineering perspectives early in the product-development process rather than waiting for finished requirements. You'll work with APIs and real-time data to create responsive, data-rich mobile experiences, making thoughtful decisions around state management, rendering, performance and architecture. You'll operate with the ownership and versatility of a product engineer, comfortable wearing multiple hats and moving between product problems and technical challenges. You'll help raise the product-engineering bar across Consumer Mobile through technical discussions, code reviews, collaboration and by demonstrating strong product ownership. What You Bring Strong React Native experience. You've built and shipped meaningful production applications using React Native and are comfortable making architectural and implementation decisions across a modern mobile codebase. A product-building mindset with strong product judgment. You start with the client problem rather than the ticket, understand what we're actually trying to solve, know when to challenge requirements or simplify solutions, and work with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into strong engineering solutions. Evidence of product impact. You can explain not only what you've built, but why you built it and what happened afterwards. You're comfortable using metrics, experimentation and client behaviour to evaluate the impact of your work. End-to-end ownership. You're comfortable working across the lifecycle of a feature: discovery, technical design, implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. Comfort with data-rich applications. You've worked with APIs and dynamic or real-time data and understand the engineering considerations involved in turning that data into responsive client experiences. Close collaboration with Product and Design. You enjoy working directly with designers and product managers, see building great products as a shared responsibility, and communicate effectively in written and verbal English across a globally distributed team. Versatility and AI proficiency. You're comfortable moving beyond a narrowly defined engineering remit, use AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, etc.) thoughtfully to move faster while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and quality, and thrive in environments where you wear multiple hats. A track record of taking loosely defined product problems and turning them into features or products that delivered measurable client impact. Nice to have Experience building products in fintech, trading, crypto, payments or another financial technology environment. An understanding of how trading, investing or financial products work and an interest in the problems our clients are trying to solve. Experience with real-time or streaming data and building interfaces where information changes rapidly. Experience working across both mobile and web, bringing valuable perspective from broader frontend or product-engineering work. Experience in a startup or small-to-medium-sized technology company where engineers work closely with Product and Design. Native mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin and an understanding of when dropping below the React Native layer is the right engineering decision. Experience improving application performance, responsiveness and reliability across a range of mobile devices. A background in taking loosely defined product problems and turning them into products or features with measurable client impact. results.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team. Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products. The opportunity Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects. Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets. Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live. Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering. Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is. Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning. What You Bring 6+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential. Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit. Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust. Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows. Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show. End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities. Nice to haves Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto. Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts. Rust experience, given our backend stack. SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data. AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach. Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents. Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close. Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team. Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life. Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact. Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally. Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives. Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap. Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers. Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes. Requirements 3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred. Experience in product development, delivery, and change management Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners. Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions. A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results. Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases. Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks. Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Colombia, with a preference of Bogota. Expect regular travel for customer onsite. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.
